evidence_refs.quote: It governs and deploys every agent, model, and MCP server in the environment; secures and observes each action before and after it executes; and optimizes agent traffic as well as spend through one controlled gateway.

WhiteMatter says it governs agents, models and Model Context Protocol servers before deployment, then observes and enforces policies as agents operate across browsers, endpoints, SaaS applications and cloud environments.
WhiteMatter is already deployed at companies including Sentara Health, Alter Domus, New American Funding, Concentrix, and many Fortune 500 organizations.

quotes.speaker: Vidit Arora
quotes.quote: "Despite all the discussion about pausing AI development, enterprises are doing the opposite," said Vidit Arora, Founder and CEO of WhiteMatter. "AI technology is too powerful, the opportunity is too significant, and the competitive pressure is too real to put it back in the box. Companies that slow down AI adoption risk being overtaken by competitors that move fast, stay secure, and scale AI with confidence, which is exactly why we built WhiteMatter."

quotes.speaker: Zishan Siddiqui
quotes.quote: "At Sentara Health, our mission is to improve health every day, and technology is increasingly important to how we deliver on that mission. As an integrated health system with both care delivery and health plan services, we made the decision early to operationalize AI rather than simply pilot it. Today, across our 35,000-person workforce, AI is increasingly becoming part of how we work, deliver care and serve our patients, members, and communities," said Zishan Siddiqui, Chief Information Security Officer at Sentara Health. "WhiteMatter is helping us scale that adoption responsibly by providing greater visibility into how AI is being used, protecting sensitive information at the point of use, and guiding our workforce toward appropriate behaviors and tools in real time. We're not governing AI to slow innovation. We're creating the trust and guardrails that allow us to innovate responsibly, keep saying yes, and ultimately advance our mission of improving health every day."

quotes.speaker: Demetry Zilberg
quotes.quote: "At Alter Domus, we scale practical AI with measured returns: squads of Industrialized Agents in production, and work that used to take a quarter now takes a week," said Demetry Zilberg, CTO of Alter Domus. "That pace is only responsible if governance keeps up. With WhiteMatter in our cyber defense stack, every agent is governed before it goes live, every tool call is policy-checked at one gateway, and the telemetry shows us where AI actually creates value. Security, adoption, and enterprise value aren't separate conversations here. They're one lifecycle, and we can see all of it."

quotes.speaker: Pramod Gosavi
quotes.quote: "Every wave of enterprise computing eventually produced its own security layer, from the network to the cloud to identity," said Pramod Gosavi at Blumberg Capital. "Agents are the next wave and could soon outnumber employees inside enterprises, requiring a governance layer built natively for them. We backed WhiteMatter because its platform approach and Guardian agent model give enterprises the guardrails an autonomous workforce needs, at a scale no human security team could manage manually."

analysis.capital_judgment: 资本押注的核心变量是：随着企业AI代理数量快速增长，代理治理与安全能否成为独立的企业软件层，并由WhiteMatter的Guardian代理架构形成可规模化的平台优势。当前融资所依赖的已验证信号包括：管理超过225万个代理、治理1160亿次AI交互、过去六个月收入增长5倍、净收入留存率约200%且零客户流失、客户数量翻三倍，以及Sentara Health、Alter Domus等企业客户的实际部署。证据边界在于：上述经营数据均为公司报告，未经独立审计；来源未披露估值或收入绝对额，因此无法判断本轮定价相对于公司规模是否合理。
validated_signals: 过去六个月收入增长5倍
净收入留存率约200%且零客户流失
Sentara Health、Alter Domus、New American Funding、Concentrix等企业客户已部署
risks: 公司报告的经营数据（收入增长、净收入留存率、客户数量等）未经独立审计，需谨慎看待。
来源未披露估值或收入绝对额，本轮定价的合理性无法验证。
AI代理治理赛道可能吸引更多竞争者，WhiteMatter需持续证明其平台方法优于单点解决方案。
公司计划大力投资高管团队和上市扩张，执行风险与成本控制仍需观察。
